acceptance_observations: Through live `mcp.Client(mcp)`, a string observed byte-for-byte as source or scope on a non-deleted entry receives eligible named plus universal blocks with no guidance; an active definition lacking memory and a name occurring only on deleted entries use fallback.

Through live `mcp.Client(mcp)`, omitted agent, null, numeric zero, blank/whitespace, `*`, and unrecognized strings return the guidance constant plus eligible universal blocks separated by two newline characters; no blocks or limit zero returns the guidance constant alone; bool, nonzero numbers, arrays, and objects fail schema validation.

Through live `mcp.Client(mcp)`, a nonblank string source including `*` creates one pending entry with empty scope; blank and non-string source values fail, and wildcard provenance does not enter recognized names.

Direct identity tests show pending, curated, approved, contested, disputed, and stale source/scope names are recognized; deleted-only and `*` names are not; host/product-style names have no denylist branch.

Save keeps existing unscoped pending creation and immutable provenance while removing only the active-definition recognition gate.
